TimePeriod: Patriarchal era (Genesis) and Isaiah's restoration vision
Region: Arabian, beside Kedar (Isaiah 60:7); the precise location is not stated
History: Nebaioth, firstborn of Ishmael, is named in the Ishmaelite list (Genesis 25:13). Esau married Mahalath, daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebajoth (Genesis 28:9; 36:3 spells the name Nebajoth), tying Nebaioth's house to Esau's line. The name returns in Isaiah 60:7, where 'the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee' at the restored Zion, beside the flocks of Kedar.
Culture: Herders of the Arabian desert, named for their rams in Isaiah's vision.
Religion: Nothing distinct is recorded of Nebaiothite religion.
BibleConnection: Nebaioth links Ishmael's firstborn to Esau's household and to Isaiah's gathered flocks.
